Subject: Post-demo security checklist & trust portal access for ClearHealth

Hi Emma — great to meet earlier today. Quick follow-up from our call and the security items you asked for: 

1) SOC 2 Type II: ClearHealth asked for the latest Type II report and an interim bridge letter — happy to provide both.
2) Trust portal access: we can provision read-only access to our evidence vault (Trust Portal) for your security team.
3) Vendor DDQ (your questionnaire): please send over the file and we’ll route to our security team for completion.
4) HIPAA / GDPR: tagging here that ClearHealth is concerned about HIPAA controls and data residency/GDPR; we can provide our BAA and data processing addendum draft.

Next steps I suggest:
- Emma to send the DDQ and the name/email for the security reviewer who needs portal access.
- Redwood to send a temporary attestation / bridge letter and a SOC2 excerpt within 48 hours.
- If you need a BAA ahead of the pilot, let me know and I’ll start the DocuSign routing.

Attachments: Meeting_Notes_post-demo.txt (demo recap + product screenshots)

Thanks — I’ll loop in Monica (security) to handle the portal + docs.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(karthik.iyer@redwood.com)

- GDPR / data locality: do you have any controls or options to keep data in EU regions if required later?

Can you and your security lead provide portal access to Tom and me so we can pull the full evidence set?

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
